ITEM 1 | Mixed salad greens on a large square white plate, leafy pieces in green, light green, and dark red-purple tones with ruffled edges and some pale yellowish-white frilly leaves; moist-looking, no dressing sheen, loosely piled covering roughly one third of the plate's lower-right area, about 14 cm across and 3 cm tall | 60
ITEM 2 | Dark red-purple lettuce leaves (a few torn pieces) scattered in the upper-middle of the greens, glossy, thin and slightly wilted, each piece about 3 to 5 cm long | 8
ITEM 3 | Partial plate on the far left edge with a light-colored, crumbly, fibrous mass mixed with dark green leafy pieces and a small amount of yellowish-brown residue, cut off by the frame, only a small visible portion | 25
